# Final bilingual author manuscript

These English and Persian Word/PDF editions are author manuscripts and have not been peer reviewed. Build with `python paper/scripts/build_publication_documents.py --format docx`, then `--format pdf`, then `--format finalize`. The build validates the frozen facts, 23 verified references, resolved citations, figures, placeholders, and output readability. PDF byte identity is not claimed because Microsoft Word may embed variable metadata.
